_comment: Shop owners' plans -> reminder tier. Each owner is one owner membership; "profile": false means that owner has no profiles row. trialDays: null = no trial date, positive = ends that many days from now, negative = ended. Read by lib/reminders/__tests__/entitlements.test.ts (reminderTierForOwners) and tests/db/run-reminders-db-tests.mjs (public.reminder_plan_tier). Both must give 'tier' for every row.
